name: cluster-builder
postCreateCommand: set -e; curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 https://get.opentofu.org/install-opentofu.sh -o /tmp/install-opentofu.sh && chmod +x /tmp/install-opentofu.sh && sudo /tmp/install-opentofu.sh --install-method standalone && rm -f /tmp/install-opentofu.sh && pip install --break-system-packages -e .
